Inglewood, California
  June 18, 2024

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
June 18, 2024, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.

The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Mayor Butts, Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, and
  Faulk; and
  Absent: None.

City officials and personnel present for Closed Session were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Mark F. Weinberg  City Manager
  Derald Brenneman  Acting City Attorney
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Butts
inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council on the
Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1, CS-2, CS-3, and CS-4.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:00 p.m. for Closed Session Item
Nos. CS-1, CS-2, CS-3, and CS-4.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the City
Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the hour
of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Gray, Padilla,
  Morales, Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Louis Atwell  Acting City Manager/Acting Executive Director*
  Derald Brenneman  Acting City Attorney/Acting General Counsel*
  Jose Cortes  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any item
on the Agendas.

There was no response.

133  ACCOMMODATION – LOUIS BROWN. The City Council presented Louis Brown
  with an Accommodation from the City of Inglewood for being a World War II Veteran and
  a long-term Inglewood resident.

  that said demands are received and filed.

  Center Fitness Room on March 4, 2024.
  5. John Mason for alleged property damage; pothole on March 15, 2024.
  6. Enid Morris for alleged personal injury; fell into an uncovered hole (SCE sheared vent
  pipe) on November 5, 2023.
  7. Kimberly Powell for alleged tire damage; pothole on December 27, 2023.
  8. Gustave Sagastume for alleged tire damage; pothole on March 5, 2024.

  1. Steven Bradford for alleged tire damage; pothole on February 26, 2024.

  1. Damage Recovery Unit Enterprise for alleged property damage – collision on May 5,

  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
